title: Canadian Film Weekly
additional-notes: This is a Canadian publication. Its contents may still be copyrighted even without renewals or copyright notices, if they meet GATT copyright restoration requirements for works first published outside the US. Spot checks of issues from 1942 (the first year of this title) show subscription rates quoted for both Canada and the US.
Spot-checks of issues from the 1960s and 1970 did not turn up copyright notices.
